Versus
 The State Of Assam
 Represented By The Public Prosecutor, Assam
Advocate for the Petitioner : MR. K MOHAMMED Advocate for the Respondent : PP, ASSAM  Page No.# 2/4
BEFORE  HONOURABLE MRS. JUSTICE MITALI THAKURIA  ORDER 23.03.2023 Heard Mr. K. Mohammed, learned counsel for the applicant.

Also heard Mr. P.
Borthakur, learned Public Prosecutor for the State respondent.
This is an application filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, praying for grant of pre-arrest bail in connection with South Salmara P.S. Case No.153/2014, registered under Sections 420/406 of the Indian penal Code.

It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant, Mr. K. Mohammed, that the informant has filed the FIR only to take revenge upon the accused/applicant as because the husband of the informant, has taken an amount of Rs.1,70,000/-(Rupees One lakh seventy thousand) only as Policy maturity value from the Nizora Thrift and Credit Cooperative Society Lmt., wherein, the accused/applicant was the chairman of the said society.

entities.text: Nizora Thrift and Credit Cooperative Society Lmt
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
After receiving the said amount, the Page No.# 1/4 vs The State Of Assam on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59218428/
1 husband of the informant approached the accused/applicant for loan against his wife.
But the accused/applicant denied it as because there is no policy in the name of his wife/informant.

Further,
the learned counsel for the applicant prays for grant of interim pre-arrest bail and submitted that he is ready to co-operate with the investigation of this case, if so granted.

In this context, Mr. P. Borthakur, learned Public Prosecutor has submitted Page No.# 3/4 that the case diary may be required at this stage to reveal the facts of this instant case and also raised no objection in the prayer made by the applicant for interim pre-arrest bail.
Considering the submissions made by the learned counsels of both sides and also considering the other aspect of the matter
, I find it a fit case to grant the privilege of interim pre-arrest bail to the accused/applicant till receipt of the case diary.

Accordingly, it is provided that in the event of arrest of the accused/applicant, namely, Shri Abu Motaleb Saikia, in connection with South Salmara P.S. Case No.153/2014, registered under Sections 420/406 of the IPC, he shall be enlarged on pre-arrest bail on his executing a bond of Rs. 20,000/-
(Rupees twenty thousand) only with one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority, subject to the following conditions:
(i) that the applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by the Investigating Officer within 7(seven) from today.
(ii) that the applicant shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer; and (iii) that the applicant shall not leave the jurisdiction of the concerned jurisdictional Magistrate, without prior permission.
Page No.# 4/4 In the meanwhile the C/D is to be called for.
